# Salamandra

> Open, community-driven 3D-printed FPV aircraft platform. The reasoning is the product:
> every decision carries its rationale, its source and its confidence level (`[M]`/`[D]`/`[E]`/`[I]`),
> and every published number can be reproduced from a validated script.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](/salmandra/guide/01-getting-started/): The shortest path from zero to a working model
- [How to read this repository](/salmandra/guide/02-how-to-read/): Folder map and traceability flow
- [Architecture](/salmandra/guide/03-architecture/): How research, decisions, gaps, tests and calculations feed each other
- [Glossary](/salmandra/guide/04-glossary/): Confidence tags, identifiers, signs and key terms
- [Contributing](/salmandra/guide/05-contributing/): Order of value of contributions and the workflow
